JOAN.acting: Joan approaches with controlled hurt, offering Bob a hard-won freedom rather than another accusation.
JOAN.head: HEAD-NONE

BOB.acting: Bob stays half-occupied with preparing to leave, guarded and uncertain about facing Joan.
BOB.head: HEAD-NONE

beats.acting: Joan's command makes Bob briefly check her reaction without yet abandoning the motorcycle.
The claim that he has won leaves Bob visibly uncertain, and he settles his attention on Joan.
Bob's question exposes the hurt beneath Joan's certainty.
Hearing freedom named aloud, Bob briefly looks down rather than meet the weight of it.
Naming the damage done to all of them brings a restrained edge of resentment into Joan's face.
Bob gives her a courteous farewell while turning his attention back toward leaving.
